name: Amamiya Seiichi
source:
The second-in-command of the Yakumo Group.
He is like an older brother to Rio and Mimu.
He is indebted to the leader of the Yakumo Group and works hard for the group.

He is trusted by the leader, executives, and other members, and they rely on him.

He has had a bad relationship with Inami since they were in the group.

[Translated from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/guiltyex/ex03/chara.html]the official site[/url]]
